rationale: Selected n1 and n2 as the optimal 2-location combination. For each fault section, the maximum patrol-time reduction among selected locations is used: s12=max(18,6)=18, s23=max(16,28)=28, s24=max(15,26)=26, s45=max(14,23)=23. The expected customer-minutes saved is calculated as sum over sections of (annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * selected_gain_minutes): 0.18*120*18 + 0.14*70*28 + 0.12*90*26 + 0.09*40*23 = 388.8 + 274.4 + 280.8 + 82.8 = 1026.8.
